event: "Yeah, definitely the small one first, that's the deer?"

changes.note: Marda hears Nala take small blight first

event: "The deer," Marda says. "North bank of the Wren Brook, below the ford, the woodcutter says."

memory.fact: Nala took the deer first; Marda said it lies on the Wren Brook's north bank, below the ford.

event: Nala walks out the south gate and down to the crossroads, then an hour into the Wrenwood.

changes.note: Nala's well fills on the walk out

event: The Wren Brook runs loud and cold. Beside its water, the blue current runs thick.
Upstream, smoke rises from the charcoal-burner's hut.

memory.fact: Charcoal-burners work clearings along the south road; one hut by the Wren Brook still smokes.

event: Three hundred paces below the ford, the frost on the north bank goes gray.

memory.fact: The rotted deer lies on the Wren Brook's north bank, about three hundred paces below the ford.
The rotted deer lies on the Wren Brook's north bank, about three hundred paces below the ford.

event: The deer lies there, two days dead, its throat torn out. Its hide has rotted to black sludge.

memory.fact: The deer is two days dead, its throat torn; blight still seeps in it and grays the frost around.
The deer is two days dead, its throat torn; blight still seeps in it and grays the frost around.
A corrupted wolf killed the deer by the Wren Brook two nights ago; its blight is fresh.

event: The blight still seeps in it. She feels it before she reaches the bank.
As soon as it's in reach, she braids a pull strand into a Current Lash and strikes.

changes.note: The braided pull costs Nala its own mana

event: The lash only cuts dead flesh. But the pull strand bites deep and draws the blight up out of it.

memory.fact: A Current Lash on a carcass only cuts dead flesh; a pull is what draws its blight.
A Current Lash on a carcass only cuts dead flesh; a pull is what draws its blight.

event: The braid pulls twice at once, two draws like a bite's. The current carries the cold off her arm.
The blight clots on the bank into a dark seed stone. Around it, the gray frost turns white again.

changes.note: The deer's blight clots into a seed stone
Mana Weaver lends the braided pull

memory.fact: Two pulls draw the deer's blight; it leaves a seed stone, and the frost round it clears.

event: She picks up the seed stone.
Then she sees the prints. Wolf prints circle the deer, bigger than any Wrenwood wolf's.
They lead down the bank and into the brook. On neither bank, up or down, do they come out.

memory.fact: Wolf prints bigger than any Wrenwood wolf's circle the deer, go into the brook, and don't come out.
